parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border or document friction, or documented police targeting is recorded; foreign documents govern the visit. Absence of legal gender recognition and GI hate-crime protection is resident-facing and, per rubric rule 1, not deducted without evidence it reaches visitors. Counterweights are thin trans-specific evidence: sexuality protections do not cover gender identity, no working GI remedy or documented social acceptance of trans people is shown, violence against LGBTQ people is only occasional and unquantified, and enforcement/custody/ward practice is undocumented. No known universal exposure, but also no documented protective operation, placing it in the 0.65 friction/uncertainty tier rather than the 0.75+ acceptance-plus-remedies tier.
